items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: I know one of the first records we made, Adelaide Hall sang, a long time ago.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah, we recorded -- we recorded, not just under Duke's name. We would cut the band up and record with different people. But I -- and we made so many records, it's hard to recollect now. It's impossible.
I know one of the first records we made, Adelaide Hall sang, a long time ago.
